description.narrative:
The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to develop the interconnection between the major cities of Douala and Bafoussam (Littoral and West regions), which is considered a bedrock of economic activities in the country. This objective is directly relevant to the problem statement, i.e. the poor condition and low level of service of the existing roads, which hinders the socio-economic development of the concerned regions (Littoral and West regions) and exposes road users to high risks of accidents and insecurity. The objective is also in line with the country's development objectives, which aim to promote regional integration, economic diversification and social inclusion through improved transport infrastructure and services to facilitate trade exchanges between Cameroon, Nigeria, Chad and the Central African Republic
The specific project objectives are: (i) improving the road condition of the N5 Douala-Bafoussam, (ii) opening up interconnection alternatives within the Douala-N'Djamena corridor, through western Cameroon, (iii) reducing transport costs, (iv) improving the living conditions of the populations of the project's area of influence including Access to Social and Economic Facilities and (v) opening up the production basins of the Littoral and West Regions of Cameroon and enhancing moving of goods to i
